symptom.value: Active-tab label renders var(--accent)#10b981 = 2.29:1 on --bg-sunken and 2.54:1 on #fff active wrapper; both fail WCAG 2.1 AA SC 1.4.3 (4.5:1 for 12.5px). Also diverges from design-fidelity-contract §5 which prescribes active-tab color: var(--text) #18181b.

affected_area.value: src/renderer/src/components/molecules/Tabs.css — .tabs__tab--active / [aria-selected='true'] color rule (line 149). Molecules/Tabs component; consumed by organisms/TabBar.

repro_or_current.value: Current: open app, view a tab strip; active tab label is emerald (--accent), low contrast. Surfaced by design-auditor during feature 011-tab-width-cap review. Pre-existing, not introduced by 011.

desired.value: 005 (this ticket): active-tab label color var(--accent)#10b981 -> var(--text)#18181b, meets WCAG AA 1.4.3 (~14:1) and design-contract §5. Combined-pass siblings: 007 close-icon var(--text-faint)#a1a1aa -> var(--text-muted)#71717a (clears 3:1 non-text 1.4.11); 006 inactive label var(--text-muted)#71717a -> needs >=4.5:1 but no existing token sits between --text-muted and --text, so likely a new mid token (~#52525b) to keep active/inactive distinction.

unchanged_behavior.value: Active vs inactive tab must stay visually distinguishable (006 fix must NOT reuse --text and collide with 005's active color). Both light AND dark theme must pass WCAG (dark tokens flip: --text #f4f4f5, --text-muted #a1a1aa, --text-faint #71717a on --bg-sunken #08080a). Accent underline (box-shadow) + --accent-soft active bg stay --accent (intended selected indicator, non-text). .tabbar-scoped feature-005 overrides must not break.

intake_classifications.statement: Active-tab text contrast: active-tab label color fails WCAG AA and diverges from design contract §5
intake_classifications.minimal_fix: In Tabs.css, change .tab.active label color from var(--accent) to var(--text) so it meets WCAG AA (>=4.5:1) and matches design-fidelity-contract §5
